summary: Built the code generation system that converts visual workflows into executable LangChain TypeScript code. Implemented CodeGenerator service with generateCode(workflow) method, topological sort (Kahn's algorithm) for correct execution order, DFS-based cycle detection, and full workflow validation. Created nodeTemplates.ts with template functions for upload, extract, transform, and output node types. Created chainTemplates.ts with generateChain() that assembles nodes using .pipe() for linear chains and RunnableSequence.from() for branching DAGs. Added codeFormatting.ts with formatImports (dedup/sort), formatVariableName (camelCase from node IDs), addComments (JSDoc per node), and generateHeader (timestamp, workflow ID, manual-edit warning). All 54 tests pass including performance tests confirming sub-500ms generation for 100-node workflows. TypeScript compiles cleanly.
